name: Etizolam
summary: Etizolam is a benzodiazepine-like medicine that calms anxiety and helps sleep. It is approved in some countries, such as Japan and Italy, but not in the United States.
description: Etizolam is a thienodiazepine, a medicine closely related to benzodiazepines. It boosts the effect of GABA, the brain’s main calming chemical, which reduces anxiety, causes sleepiness, relaxes muscles, and helps prevent seizures. It is approved for short-term treatment of anxiety and insomnia in certain countries, such as Japan and Italy, but is not approved in the United States. It is sometimes found sold as a “research chemical” or in illegal markets.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Etizolam is a thienodiazepine derivative structurally related to benzodiazepines. It acts as a positive allosteric modulator of the GABA-A receptor, producing anxiolytic, hypnotic, sedative, muscle relaxant, and anticonvulsant effects. It is approved for short-term treatment of anxiety and insomnia in certain countries, such as Japan and Italy, but is not approved in the United States. It is sometimes encountered as a research chemical or in illicit markets.
